name: RWTH Aachen University
description: RWTH Aachen University is a public technical university in Aachen, founded in 1870 as a polytechnic school. It has about 44,000 students and concentrates on engineering and the natural sciences.
whyIncluded: RWTH lists 23 English-taught master's programmes, and Germany is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 640 in UNESCO UIS data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: RWTH 'Costs' page / 'Costs of Studying in Aachen 2026': budget at least EUR 1,100 a month. Midpoints of the published ranges: accommodation and associated costs 400-600 -> 500; food 200-300 -> 250; personal = study materials 20-40 + internet and mobile phone 20-50 + additional costs (clothing, hygiene) 50-200 -> 30 + 35 + 125 = 190. Transport 0 because the Deutschlandsemesterticket is part of the semester contribution. Health insurance (100-150) excluded.
